ceiling_origin.classification: Vehicle-A calibration-specific historical value, not a fundamental LOS-guidance property and not derived from actuator limits
evidence: The 150 N surge and 100 Nm yaw limits entered the repository with the Vehicle A reference-calibration implementation and protocol.
The same values were later copied verbatim into portable-controllers.ts.
Vehicle A's actuator normalization also uses 150 as a denominator, but no derivation ties the 150/100 pair to its two physical thruster limits or moment arms.
The frozen Vehicle A protocol explicitly records these as its wrench limits; Vehicle C has two 500 N azimuth thrusters and approximately 810 Nm differential longitudinal-thrust yaw authority.
